system.description:
Take one design flaw per purchase (each flaw once) for a VP rebate.

  • External Power. Runs on beamed or cabled power; beamed power needs line of sight to the source.
  • Feedback. Each time the vehicle is damaged the pilot tests Athletics + Constitution at TN 15 or takes 1 level of fatigue.
  • Hangar Queen. After each sortie it needs upkeep lasting the deployment time plus 8 hours.
  • Inefficient Controls. Move costs a Full Action and Punch It is unavailable.
  • Junker. Any damage suffered triggers a roll on the crit chart.
  • Overheating. Loses 1 HP in each round with Momentum over 6 or in which Punch It is used.
  • Unstable. Control tests suffer 2 checks.
system.effect: Take one design flaw per purchase (each flaw once) for a VP rebate.
